highway_loop.label: Highway-gated Loop (adapted)
highway_loop.status: Proposed mechanism control; not implemented or trained in this repository
highway_loop.source_method: Training Very Deep Networks, NeurIPS 2015, Section 2 Eq. (3) and Section 2.2
highway_loop.adaptation: Apply the Highway transform gate to the recurrent carry, with the same shared GPT Transformer and the same candidate computation as Invariant Loop.
highway_loop.gate: g_t=sigmoid(W_g h_previous+b_g), one vector per token; W_g,b_g shared across loops
highway_loop.aggregation: h_t=(1-g_t) elementwise_mul h_previous + g_t elementwise_mul c_t
highway_loop.scope: The adaptation is not a published Highway Transformer architecture or a reproduction of an existing experiment.

vanilla.scope: Overall architectural reference; it retains its ordinary raw-output recurrence and is not matched for the soft-feedback candidate.

invariant.existing_state_mlp: The existing state-mlp handoff retains mass normalization, so it is not the proposed sigmoid Highway control.
